title_en: Psychology Made Simple (16/20): Why a Good Night's Sleep Matters
note_en: 不是…而是… means "not A, but B": 不是手机的问题，而是睡眠本身出了问题 "it wasn't the phone; the problem was the sleep itself." The text uses the same frame to correct a common belief: 大脑并没有完全休息，而是在做重要的工作 "the brain doesn't fully rest but is doing important work." Note that it's 而是, not just 是, that introduces the true alternative, and the first half usually needs a negative (不是, 没有).
